types.nativeOwnership: owns core async state and completed MIGraphXArgumentCollection; does not own HipStream
types.managedOwnership: completion state and owned host output snapshot
types.disposeBehavior: blocks on the supplied stream when unfinished; finalizer is not used for blocking cleanup
types.failureCleanup: completion copy errors are stored as the primary error after native outputs and input leases release

types.managedOwnership: immutable name, shape, and memory references
types.disposeBehavior: not disposable; the async result owns only a scoped pointer lease
types.failureCleanup: pointer lease releases on enqueue failure or stream completion

types.nativeOwnership: HipSharp owns stream SafeHandle and pending list
types.managedOwnership: adapter callback is registered under HipStream lock
types.disposeBehavior: HipStream Query/Synchronize/Dispose releases callback exactly once
types.failureCleanup: enqueue failure does not register pending work
types.afterOwnerDispose: adapter cannot enqueue on a disposed stream

types.nativeOwnership: DangerousAddRef SafeHandle leases for program, parameter map, and copied arguments
types.managedOwnership: lease set held by core async state
types.disposeBehavior: caller Dispose is deferred until stream completion
types.failureCleanup: reverse-order release on native enqueue failure
types.afterOwnerDispose: early Dispose is safe while the run is pending

types.nativeOwnership: returned output collection remains owned by core async state until snapshot
types.managedOwnership: outputs become independent host-backed MIGraphXArgument instances
types.failureCleanup: partial copies are disposed before the primary copy error is stored

types.nativeOwnership: HipSharp runtime performs borrowed-pointer D2H; adapter never frees the pointer
types.managedOwnership: new byte[] is copied into an owned MIGraphXArgument
types.disposeBehavior: copy occurs only after stream completion
types.failureCleanup: pinned managed destination is freed in finally
types.afterOwnerDispose: no raw device pointer is exposed
